# Flappy Bird

> A Python + Pygame recreation of Flappy Bird, engineered with precise
> collision physics, optimized game loop timing, and arcade-style
> responsiveness.

Author: Amey Thakur, ORCID 0000-0001-5644-1575
Co-author: Mega Satish, ORCID 0000-0002-1844-9557
